metadata.description: RTD plugin marketplace for Claude Code

plugins.name: oberskills
plugins.description: Advanced Claude Code skills for prompt optimization, agent dispatch enforcement, skill creation and review, screenshot analysis, web search, and human-sounding writing

plugins.name: code-foundations
plugins.description: Software engineering skills distilled from the industry's favorite books. Checklist-driven code review, debugging, whiteboarding, and quality gates.

plugins.name: design-for-ai
plugins.description: A design-foundations system with a four-stage workflow (research → plan → mock → build) — doctrine-read design knowledge, a seeded composition dealer with user-pinnable axes, dual-blind review, and gated design artifacts.

plugins.name: react-native-foundations
plugins.description: React Native development skills — documentation search, iOS Simulator control, error diagnosis, runtime debugging, layout inspection, accessibility auditing, and coding guidance.

plugins.name: svelte-foundations
plugins.description: Svelte and SvelteKit development skills — documentation search, browser automation via CDP, error diagnosis, coding guidance, and accessibility auditing.

plugins.name: claude-mux
plugins.description: MCP server for tmux control and multi-agent coordination. Spawn workers, coordinate via messaging, share task lists, and manage tmux sessions from Claude Code.

plugins.name: grug-brain
plugins.description: Persistent memory for LLMs with FTS5 search, docs indexing, dreaming, and shared brain sync. Markdown storage, git-tracked history, cross-linking.

plugins.name: penman
plugins.description: Markdown to rich text for any platform — Slack, Teams, Discord, Notion, Word, Outlook, Gmail, Confluence, Jira, PowerPoint. Copies styled HTML to clipboard ready to paste.

plugins.name: judge-fable
plugins.description: Dispatch a Fable 5 subagent to review, judge, or answer a hard artifact under a curated discipline brief, returning only a distilled, evidence-backed verdict.
